card.name: Digits inside sports scores and team counts
card.fires_on: The digit 1 or other digits inside game scores like 17-14 or 15-a-side, and sometimes small words in sports rules text. It is strongest in sports results and rule descriptions.

modes.description: A digit within a final score or vote split such as 17-14 or 5-4.
